children: Fujikura Ltd.'s key growth driver has shifted to Asia, say Jefferies analysts in a note. North America remains the largest earnings contributor, but Asia excluding Japan and China has emerged as the growth engine for the Japanese electrical equipment maker as AI data‑center projects are driving a sharp increase in demand for optical components and engineering services, they say. Jefferies expects fiscal-year operating profit of 498.8 billion yen, which is higher than the company's forecast of Y432 billion. The bank analysts believe Fujikura remains one of the clearest beneficiaries of the global AI infrastructure cycle. Jefferies raises its target price to Y11,700 from Y9,300 and maintains a buy rating. Shares are 3.8% higher at Y5,245. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
